Job Description:
Senior QA Automation Engineer
Amsterdam, The Netherlands (Hybrid)

About this position:
Context Labs is seeking a Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer. You will be responsible for leading the testing effort for Context Labs products and helping define the testing workflow. You have excellent interpersonal skills, are organized, detail-oriented and a motivated self-starter that can easily adapt to a fast-paced environment. This position reports directly to the CTO.

In this role you will:
Work closely with the CTO, developers, and other stakeholders.
Participate in the effort to define and implement best practices for testing, performance, and maintainability.
Work with cross-functional teams spanning product, development, data science, and research teams to drive engineering decisions.
Drive creation of scripts for automation of repetitive and routine tasks in CI/CD.
Manage test implementation projects which could include new tools and new versions of existing tools.
Implement automated tests using various languages and tools including JavaScript, Python, and Java.
Mentor and train other engineers.
Make technical decisions and collaborate with TC team and others to implement a comprehensive test automation strategy.
Assess test quality, coverage, and team’s automation maturity.
Stay ahead of the curve for innovative technologies and techniques with an eye towards the continual improvement of both the team’s skillset and automation strategy.
Anything else as may reasonably be required by the company.

Experience:
7+ years of experience in Development or QA Automation.
Hands-on experience with automated testing tools (e.g., Playwright, Nightwatch, Selenium, Cypress, TestNG, Junit, or similar) and Microservice Testing tools (Postman, Jest).
Experience developing E2E and API tests.
Understanding of CI/CD practices and experience working with tools like Jenkins, Bitbucket, GitHub or similar.
Experience with one or more Test Case Management Tools (Rally, Quality Center/ALM, TestRail, etc.) with Playwright as a plus.
Experience in cloud service (SaaS & PaaS) testing.
Strong problem-solving, analytical, and troubleshooting skills.
Knowledge of Jira, DevOps, Agile/Scrum Methodologies.
Experience with data pipelines is a plus, ensuring data integrity throughout the entire pipeline by implementing thorough testing at each stage.

Preferred Experience:
B.S. Computer Science, other scientific degree, or equivalent work experience.
Experience with TestRail is a plus.

Why you’ll like it here:
Context Labs is collaborative at its core. You’ll work within your team and across the organization allowing for continuous learning and discovery.
We set goals that matter and provide value in all that we do, from building meaningful products to positively impacting carbon reduction and climate change.
Context Labs’ mission is to transform complex data into continuously proven information. Powered by Immutably™, an innovative, trusted data fabric platform, our integrated solutions deliver context-driven insights that enable human networks to spot patterns, correlate trends - and reveal the ground truth hidden inside the world’s most complicated, persistent problems.

We understand that applying for a job can be intimidating. Applicants rarely meet every single job requirement, and we know there are many skills and backgrounds that will contribute to success in this role. If you’re interested in applying, please do so.

Context Labs embraces diversity and equal opportunity. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We believe the more inclusive we are, the better our products will be. Context Labs will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require accommodation, please contact Erica Mackoff at HR@contextlabs.com.

Who we are:
Context Labs builds industrial AI data infrastructure for global markets, giving energy and industrial companies trusted data and AI outputs they can defend. Its platform turns fragmented operational and emissions data into continuously proven information, while sensitive data stays within each company’s own environment. Because the data is verified and the workflows validated, one platform can support any output, from carbon management and compliance to commercial use. The company grew out of research at MIT and is led by a team that helped build the internet at scale through earlier companies. Context Labs has offices in Amsterdam, Cambridge, Mass., and Houston, TX. Learn more at www.contextlabs.com.

Job Description:
About Marktplaats

Marktplaats is one of the Netherlands' leading online marketplaces, helping make commerce more sustainable by giving products an extended life. With over 2.1 million buyers and sellers visiting our platform every day, around 350,000 new listings added daily and users spending an average of 22 minutes per visit, we're building a platform that people use and trust. Every connection we enable helps people save money, earn money and reduce waste. As part of Adevinta, one of Europe's leading online classifieds groups, we're building products that make buying and selling second-hand products simpler, safer and better for everyone.

This role sits within our Product & Technology function in our Amsterdam office, home to over 300 talented professionals, where cross-functional teams design, develop and scale the products that millions of users rely on every day across our Benelux marketplaces, Marktplaats and 2dehands/2ememain. This role is on the internal IT side of that function, building the platforms and automation the whole company runs on.

You'll own the IT infrastructure, SaaS ecosystem, identity and access management, and automation for ~350 colleagues, reducing manual work, optimising processes, and building a setup that scales without adding complexity. This is a hands-on role: we want IT here to work like engineering, not a support desk. AI is changing what a small IT team can do and we want to be at the front of that, not catching up. Today that means Claude, ChatGPT, and Copilot, and you'll constantly be asking where AI can take work off our plate next.

You'll join our newly formed BNL IT team of four, reporting to the Head of IT. You'll work most closely with our Service Delivery Lead, and you'll be the first dedicated platform and automation engineer here, so you help decide how this works rather than inheriting it.

What You Will Do

Automation and engineering (core focus)

Identify manual processes and eliminate them
Build automated workflows and integrations across our systems
Write scripts and tooling to replace manual steps
Design, run and improve the infrastructure our teams use to ship the things they build with AI

Cloud, infrastructure and SaaS

Manage our cloud infrastructure and apply infrastructure-as-code
Own the SaaS ecosystem end to end: configuration, lifecycle and integrations
Own our AI tooling, steer where it goes next, and watch what it costs
Keep backup, restore and monitoring in place and tested

Identity and access

Own our identity platform, SSO, MFA and access provisioning
Design and maintain joiner/mover/leaver workflows

Endpoints, network and support

Manage endpoints, device management and the office network
Act as escalation point for complex technical issues, working closely with Service Delivery
Manage vendor escalations and SLA oversight, and support onboarding of new toolsWho You Are

Who You Are

8+ years in a broad IT role (IT Generalist, Systems Engineer, or similar), running and managing complex technical environments
Hands-on experience owning an identity platform: SSO, MFA, provisioning and joiner/mover/leaver automation
Strong experience with AWS (or similar), Terraform or IaC tooling, and CI/CD (e.g. GitHub Actions)
Able to script and build tooling, preferably in Python
Strong understanding of SaaS environments and networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, WiFi)
Strong English communication skills
Automation mindset: you actively eliminate manual work and have built integrations using APIs or workflow tools (e.g. n8n, Workato, Zapier)
Comfortable working with non-technical colleagues and translating between business needs and technical solutions
Excited about what AI can do for IT and have built things that show it

Bonus Points

You tinker outside work: a homelab, a side project, or a tool you couldn't leave alone
Have run AI tools at company level, not just used them
Have owned an entire IT estate before, in a scale-up or a small team
Service desk or ITSM experience

Infrastructure as code and CI/CD: Terraform, GitHub, GitHub Actions

Our DNA

Our culture is built on these five principles, shaping how we work together, build products and create value for our customers.

🛠️ Ownership: We take ownership, step in where needed and make things happen.
